name: Gilded Tern boarding
notes: The first time the player steps onto the Gilded Tern's deck (scene wendmouth-harbour, mw-e40.28) the latch writes tern.boarded = true and keeps it. The deck volume covers the ship's main deck (x 31-39, z 104-146 at y 2.5), above the gangway gate; the gate opens only to Hesketh's tern-gangway-pass token. tern.sailed stays Act III (mw-e39.39).
